title: My Wandering Warrior Existence
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An autobiographical comic by Nagata Kabi: after a friend's wedding she decides she wants to marry and to love and be loved, though she has no partner, no dating experience and her only sexual encounters have been with a lesbian escort service; she tries a photoshoot, a dating app and more (Seven Seas blurb via MU). The Okazu review says the book also recounts childhood sexual assault and its retraumatizing effects, and explores her body, sexuality and gender, self-care and self-love. One volume.
life_message: Learning to care for and accept oneself is the ground for seeking love.

content.note: Childhood sexual assault recounted as past trauma (Okazu).
